vocals.provenance: Existing HTDemucs vocals cache; separation script uses shifts=0 and retains original sample count/timebase. No new separation or download.
vocals.caveat: An estimated stem contains separation artifacts/leakage; levels are not an isolated studio vocal master.

measurement.rms: Window-weighted stereo-channel power average, expressed in dBFS; no mono cancellation.
measurement.spectralFlatness: Geometric/arithmetic mean spectral power in 1.5–6.5 kHz.

displayMapping.calibration: Track-relative percentiles within supplied sung-word windows, excluding vocal RMS below -65 dBFS.
displayMapping.smoothing: Source-time one-pole with separate attack/release constants; intentional envelope response, no media clock offset.
displayMapping.phase: Trapezoidal integral of rate over source seconds, beginning at zero. Lookup/interpolate this phase; never integrate browser elapsed time.
displayMapping.lookup: Interpolate neighboring rows at video.currentTime * frameRate; use stored phase for animation, current media time for word focus.
displayMapping.semanticLimit: Amplitude/high-mid/flatness proxy only; does not classify a scream, singer or emotional intent.
